statedFacts: An isotropic point source is submerged at depth h below a water surface.
The water refractive index is the symbolic parameter mu.
An opaque floating disc hides the source; problem asks for minimum disc radius.
missingForNative: Numeric source depth and water index
Opaque disc in 3D and observer/visibility definition
source.condition: Symbolic h and mu cannot be silently replaced with specific material/depth for original numerical answer.

geometry.ideal3D: A single infinite planar horizontal interface separating two homogeneous isotropic transparent media. Point source at (0,0,-h). Disc is opaque, circular, centered at (0,0,0), lies in interface plane.
geometry.rotationalSymmetry: All azimuthal angles share the same polar Snell/TIR condition; 2D meridional cross-section is not 3D validation by a sampled ray or a line blocker.
geometry.upwardRayDefinition: Ray with initial polar angle theta in [0,90deg) from upward normal; surface radial hit r=h*tan(theta)
geometry.escapeCondition: For inside index n1>outside n0, transmitted upward rays have theta<critical arcsin(n0/n1); all surface intersections have 0<=r<Rlim
geometry.coverage: Disc radius >=Rlim conditionally intercepts all *geometrically* upward transmitted rays; does not prove human visibility, diffraction/finite optical power, coating behavior.
geometry.equality: At exact critical angle transmitted grazing branch is numerically uncertain and not necessary to assert physical escape; Rlim is limiting supremum, not a detected critical photon.
geometry.ifInsideNotGreater: n1<=n0 allows arbitrarily near-grazing rays at unbounded surface radius; no finite disc covers every geometrical upward outgoing direction over an infinite plane.

native.testOnly: Pinned PhyDemo public v5 SingleRay from a fully authored below-interface medium to PlaneGlass; test only true native surface interactions. No physical disc exists in this 2D model.

gate: One focused independent review of final exact-tested combined source, NOT of unchanged historical PlanarGlass or line blockers; leave draft unmerged until owner release decision.
